observed_parent_evidence.source_basis_runtime: full-precision/local PyTorch Qwen3-0.6B source checkpoint runtime
observed_parent_evidence.native_application_runtime: Q8_0 GGUF through pinned llama.cpp llama_set_adapter_cvec

new_material_finding.statement: The credited native Q8_0 cvec PASS reuses a 1024D direction reconstructed in the full-precision PyTorch source runtime and applies those coordinates to the quantized GGUF carrier. This establishes bounded cross-runtime control transfer through the native carrier. It does not by itself establish that the Q8_0 carrier's own activation geometry contains the same semantic subspace, preserves the same class-centroid geometry, or would independently reconstruct the same direction.
new_material_finding.why_material: A training or reusable J-Space claim needs to distinguish a direction that merely remains an effective actuator after quantization from a semantic representation that is stably realized by the target carrier itself. Quantization can preserve behavior while rotating, rescaling or deforming internal geometry enough to invalidate raw-vector identity as representation evidence.

primary_hypothesis.statement: At the frozen nonterminal layer and matched token scope, the label-free three-state semantic subspace is preserved sufficiently between the exact full-precision Qwen3-0.6B source runtime and the exact Q8_0 GGUF target runtime that independently reconstructed subspaces align and yield compatible class-selective causal effect matrices on fresh holdout.
primary_hypothesis.prediction: Independent calibration-only basis reconstruction in both carriers produces above-null principal-angle/subspace alignment, stable leave-one-family-out geometry, and target-specific intervention effects with the same preregistered sign/selectivity structure after within-carrier norm calibration.

counterhypotheses.statement: The full-precision direction remains an effective perturbation of the Q8_0 model even though the Q8_0 carrier independently realizes a materially rotated or deformed semantic geometry.
counterhypotheses.prediction: Source-to-Q8 steering can remain positive while independently reconstructed Q8 geometry has poor principal-angle/coherence agreement or yields a different causal effect matrix.

counterhypotheses.statement: Apparent carrier agreement is created by raw intervention scale or operating-point choice rather than preserved representation geometry.
counterhypotheses.prediction: Agreement disappears after residual-norm-relative within-carrier dose calibration and calibration-only operating-point freezing.

counterhypotheses.statement: Cross-runtime agreement is driven by broadcast token scope or output realization rather than carrier-invariant semantics.
counterhypotheses.prediction: Agreement changes materially under scope-matched PyTorch ALL_PROMPT_TOKENS versus native ALL_PROMPT_TOKENS_CVEC comparison, or fails context-bound multi-codebook/downstream-transport endpoints.

proposed_discriminator.name: NATIVE_CARRIER_GEOMETRY_PARITY_AND_CROSS_RUNTIME_CAUSAL_MATRIX/v1
phase_0_freeze: Freeze exact source checkpoint/tokenizer/runtime build, exact Q8_0 GGUF, llama.cpp commit/build, layer 20, hidden dimension, token-scope condition and activation-capture semantics.

Freeze label-free lexical calibration families, fresh holdout families, semantic-target x output-code factorial, context-valid codebook families, downstream transport endpoint and all nuisance controls before holdout.
Select intervention dose only on calibration and express it relative to the local residual/activation norm for each carrier; do not equate raw gain across runtimes.
Do not use source-runtime basis bytes as the target-runtime basis for the geometry-parity decision.
phase_1_independent_native_geometry_reco: Capture matched calibration activations independently from the full-precision source runtime and the Q8_0 target runtime at the declared nonterminal site and token scope.
For each carrier compute label-free AFFIRMATIVE/NEGATIVE/NEUTRAL family centroids and the centered rank-1/rank-2 semantic simplex using the same deterministic estimator specification.
Persist exact activation digests, family identities, model/runtime identities and estimator receipt; holdout remains unopened.
phase_2_geometry_comparison: Compare one- and two-dimensional subspaces with principal angles rather than raw vector equality.
Compare class-centroid distance structure after carrier-local normalization.
Require leave-one-family-out subspace stability and a deterministic class/family permutation null.
Treat estimator disagreement as negative evidence; do not select the estimator that best aligns after seeing target results.
phase_3_causal_effect_matrix: Within each carrier, apply its independently reconstructed class directions using the same semantic-target x output-code counterbalanced design and matched controls.
Measure the class-selective causal matrix D[i,j] plus downstream nonterminal semantic-state transport and context-bound output behavior.

Where exact coordinate/site semantics permit, add cross-carrier source-basis-to-target and target-basis-to-source interventions as transfer probes, but never let cross-transfer substitute for independent within-carrier reconstruction.
SIGN_FLIP must reverse the preregistered selectivity pattern; null, orthogonal, permuted and lexical-nuisance controls must not reproduce it.

phase_4_classification.CARRIER_INVARIANT_SEMANTIC_SUBSPACE_CAND: Independent source and Q8 subspaces align above null and both reproduce compatible class-selective causal/transport matrices on unopened holdout.
phase_4_classification.TARGET_NATIVE_SUBSPACE_PRESENT_BUT_NOT_C: Q8 independently supports a stable causal semantic subspace, but geometry/effect alignment with the source carrier fails the preregistered parity gate.
phase_4_classification.CROSS_RUNTIME_CONTROL_TRANSFER_WITHOUT_N: The imported source direction steers Q8, but Q8-native reconstruction/coherence/causal geometry fails or is unresolved.
phase_4_classification.MEASUREMENT_OR_SCOPE_CONFOUNDED: Carrier conclusion depends on raw gain, token scope, code realization, estimator choice or holdout-sensitive operating point.

cycle_1_two_test_selection.purpose: Discriminate a genuine label-free semantic J-Space state from compliance, lexical/output-code, one-dimensional-collapse, token-scope, first-token/readout and narrow-output-path explanations.
Discriminate preserved target-carrier semantic geometry from mere effectiveness of an imported full-precision steering actuator after Q8_0 quantization.
components: independent source and Q8 calibration-only subspace reconstruction
principal-angle and centroid-geometry parity against permutation null
within-carrier causal effect matrices plus bounded cross-carrier transfer probes

external_research_inputs.source: Wu, Zhao, Chen (2026), When Is a Steerable Concept Representation Real? Measurement Confounds in a Cross-Family Audit of Neuroscience Parallels in LLMs, arXiv:2608.08159
external_research_inputs.protocol_use: Use carrier-local residual-norm-comparable interventions and freeze operating point on calibration before holdout; raw gain equality is not measurement equivalence.

Provides a native GGUF control-vector generation donor path, showing that target-carrier-native vector construction is an actionable engineering direction rather than requiring source-runtime vector reuse forever.

external_research_inputs.source: Quantization as a Perturbation: the Framing of Quantization in Language Models, arXiv:2403.06408
external_research_inputs.protocol_use: Treat quantization as a potential perturbation of weights/activations; behavioral survival of a transferred direction is not automatically internal-geometry equivalence.

external_research_inputs.source: LRQuant: Learnable and Robust Post-Training Quantization for Large Language Models, ACL 2024
external_research_inputs.protocol_use: Uses full-precision-versus-quantized block-output similarity as a representation-preservation diagnostic donor; Clay requires stronger causal/subspace parity rather than cosine similarity alone.
